description: Create an SLO correction to exclude a time period from SLO calculations (maintenance, deployments)

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Required if end is not provided

end.description: ISO 8601 end time. Required if duration is not provided

sloId.description: The SLO ID to apply the correction to

start.description: ISO 8601 start time of the correction period

timezone.description: Timezone for display (defaults to UTC). Example: Asia/Seoul

name: create-slo-correction
